title: Why Drawing Tablet Brands Won't Collaborate on Linux Floss Drivers
summary: This article by artist and open-source contributor David Revoy examines the business, legal, and technical reasons why major drawing tablet manufacturers (Wacom, Huion, XP-Pen, etc.) refuse to collaborate with the Linux FLOSS community on open-source drivers. The author, who maintains the Digikam color picker and has personal experience with Linux tablet support, analyzes the underlying dynamics that perpetuate this fragmentation.
problem_solved: Explains why drawing tablet manufacturers won't work with the Linux open-source community to create shared driver infrastructure.
why_valuable: Provides rare insider perspective on the economic and technical barriers preventing cross-brand collaboration in Linux hardware support, helping the community understand why fragmentation persists.
